new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f5daa44
--- /dev/null
+++ b/postmortem.md
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+# Incident Postmortem: High p99 HTTP Latency on booklogr-api
+
+## Root Cause
+1. **Unreachable External Data Providers & High Request Timeouts**:
+   - `BookProvider` in `api/book_provider.py` defaulted to `openlibrary` (`https://openlibrary.org`) as the primary provider and `https://metadata.booklogr.app` as the fallback provider.
+   - External calls to `openlibrary.org` and `metadata.booklogr.app` were failing/timing out with 30-second timeouts (`timeout=30`), causing search requests to block Gunicorn worker threads for long durations.
+   - The local metadata service `http://book-metadata:8080` (active in Prometheus targets) was not configured as the default provider in `api/config.py` and `api/book_provider.py`.
+
+2. **Disabled Response Caching & Cache Key Scope**:
+   - Response caching was disabled in `api/config.py` (`CACHE_TYPE = "NullCache"`), forcing every search query to hit the data provider.
+   - The `@cache.cached` decorator in `api/routes/books.py` used `request.path` rather than `request.full_path` in its key prefix.
+
+## Evidence Used
+- Prometheus metrics (`histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, path) (rate(flask_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[2m])))`) identified `/v1/books/search` as the sole high latency endpoint (~2.484s vs 300ms threshold).
+- Prometheus targets (`$PROM_URL/api/v1/targets`) showed `book-metadata:8080` active and healthy. Direct curl calls to `http://book-metadata:8080/v1/search/<query>` completed in milliseconds.
+- Direct test calls to `https://openlibrary.org` timed out (curl error 28).
+
+## Changes Made
+1. `api/config.py`:
+   - Updated default `DATA_PROVIDER` and `DATA_PROVIDER_FALLBACK` to `http://book-metadata:8080`.
+   - Changed `CACHE_TYPE` from `"NullCache"` to `"SimpleCache"`.
+
+2. `api/book_provider.py`:
+   - Updated `BookProvider.__init__` and fallback logic to default `openlibrary` and `https://metadata.booklogr.app` to `http://book-metadata:8080`.
+   - Reduced HTTP request timeouts from 30s to 3s to prevent worker thread starvation.
+
+3. `api/routes/books.py`:
+   - Updated search cache key prefix to use `request.full_path` so cache keys include query parameters (`?q=...`).
